title: R1 RESEARCH: Schumpeter-Mokyr validation memo - turnover rates, the inverted U, and the RoL norms audit against Part A
description: Part B of the addendum (docs/serenissima-addendum-ii-reputation-westphalia.md, PART B) is a STANDING RESEARCH DIRECTIVE with zero build authorization (coordinator decision AB1: RESEARCH ONLY). Its own status update says the turnover-vs-continuity tension is now resolved by design in section A.3, so this task is VALIDATION, not discovery: test the design against the sources. Three questions, all from Part B items 1-3: (1) Aghion-Howitt creative destruction (Econometrica 1992) mapped onto precedent turnover - what turnover rate of precedents is HEALTHY vs OSSIFYING vs CHAOTIC, and what entry barriers does the overruling protocol accidentally create (including the new A.3.1 requirement that every overruling embed the overruled ratio); (2) the competition-innovation inverted U (Aghion et al, QJE 2005) mapped onto how many cells should share adjacent jurisdictions (section C.4.1) and how contestable a domain charter should be (section C.4); (3) Mokyr's fragmentation plus Republic of Letters thesis - which RoL norms of open correspondence, citation, priority and reputation are still MISSING from Part A, and did the historical RoL suffer citation gaming or reputational rent extraction, and how was it policed. Also check coordinator decision AB9's two open questions against the sources. Output docs/precedent-research/12-schumpeter-mokyr-validation.md. Same discipline as the eleven prior research documents (T-330..T-338, T-350, T-351): web research with named sources, per-claim tagging, both mandatory sections, at least one finding that cuts against the commissioning brief. CONTRADICTIONS ARE THE PAYLOAD; confirmation is the null result. This task GATES NOTHING by design - T-368 does not depend on it - and it must never wait on the build half; its contradictions are dispositioned one by one at the epic join T-375.
acceptance_criteria: OWNS EXACTLY ONE FILE (create only this): docs/precedent-research/12-schumpeter-mokyr-validation.md. Use mkdir -p on the parent (idempotent, race-safe: T-366 and T-367 run in parallel and share no file). Do NOT create or edit docs/precedent-research/README.md - that index is owned solely by the epic join T-375 (F1 single-owner rule). Do NOT edit 01..11, any synthesis document, PRECEDENT.md, INTERPRETIVE-CODE.md, any record under .harness/precedents/, or anything else under .harness/.

WEB RESEARCH IS REQUIRED: at least 6 named sources, of which at least 3 are PRIMARY (the 2025 Nobel committee scientific-background document; the 1992 Econometrica article; the 2005 QJE article; a named-author book, peer-reviewed article, published lecture or symposium contribution). Every source listed in a final Sources section with a retrievable identifier (author, title, venue, year, plus URL and retrieval date). A parametric-only claim with no locatable source is tagged SPECULATION, never ESTABLISHED.

SOURCING DISCIPLINE, per Part B item 4, is itself an acceptance criterion: legitimate open sources only - the Nobel scientific background document, openly available working papers and lectures, published reviews and symposia. Quote within fair-use bounds. Do NOT source books from unauthorized copies: A Culture of Growth (Princeton, 2016) must be reached through legitimate open material (reviews, symposia, the author's own lectures and papers, or fair-use quotation from a legitimately accessible copy). For each source, state in one clause how it was legitimately obtained.

EVERY substantive claim carries exactly one tag: ESTABLISHED (attributable to a named source in the Sources section), ANALOGY (a mapping from economics or history onto agent mechanics - your inference, not the source's claim), or SPECULATION (neither). An untagged substantive claim is a defect and grounds for REJECT.

SUBSTANCE FLOOR, all three answered explicitly with sources: (a) TURNOVER - what the growth literature actually supports about healthy vs ossifying vs chaotic turnover, stated numerically or ordinally where the sources allow and stated plainly as unavailable where they do not, plus the entry barriers the overruling protocol creates (PRECEDENT.md section 7 plus the A.3.1 embedding requirement); (b) INVERTED U - what it implies for the count of cells sharing adjacent jurisdictions and for charter contestability, including whether the U's shape survives the mapping at all; (c) ROL NORMS AUDIT - the four norms of section A.1 checked one by one against Part A, naming which are present, which are missing, and which are present in a weakened form.

MUST ANSWER AB9's TWO OPEN QUESTIONS against the sources, by name (.harness/coordinator-decisions-addendum-ii.md, AB9): OQ1 - section A.3.4 pays consolidation credit to the AUTHOR while PR-015 counts only distinct-identity confirmations, so an author who recruits confirmers buys their own consolidation credit; did the historical RoL face the confirmation-cartel analogue and how was it policed. OQ2 - section A.2 makes standing portable while C.4.5 pays cells for outcomes, recreating a free-agent market; how did the RoL price mobile stars, and did reputational rent extraction follow. Where the sources are silent, say so plainly - silence is a finding, not a gap to fill with prose.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Implications for the agent harness': map each finding onto the real substrate by name - the overruling protocol (PRECEDENT.md section 7), the graded-force model with its REITERATION_N and DECAY_N calibrations (PRECEDENT.md section 19), PR-015's distinct-identity confirmation floor, PR-016's citation principle, the Phase A event types of AB2, the section A.7 weighting principle, and the C.4 cell charter. For each finding state which schema field, CLI surface, record or protocol rule it demands, or state explicitly that it demands none.

MANDATORY SECTION titled exactly 'Extends, does not duplicate': for every doctrine that already has a partial answer in this repo, cite it by file and section and say whether the finding EXTENDS the existing record or would DUPLICATE it. Address by name: docs/precedent-research/09-mechanism-design-market-primitives.md (the existing Part III research doc), 07-failure-modes.md (ossification and citation inflation), 08-graeber-wengrow-steelman.md (the standing caution), 11-reasoning-burden-calibration.md, and PRECEDENT.md sections 10.1 and 10.4. Rationale: a layer that re-does existing verification measurably regressed the corpus system (papers/agentic_harness_engineering.pdf:8 Table 3 RQ3a).

MUST TEST THE ADDENDUM, NOT FLATTER IT: section A.3 asserts that proper overruling costs the overruled author nothing, that overruling credit accrues only on sustained displacement, and that silent divergence is the only reputational crime. Section A.7 asserts that adversarial work is scarcer and must pay more. State for each whether your sources SUPPORT, CONTRADICT or QUALIFY it, with the citation. A research document with zero friction against its commissioning brief is treated as unverified cheerleading and is grounds for REJECT.

MANDATORY: state at least one finding that CUTS AGAINST Part A, Part C, or coordinator decisions AB1-AB10 where the sources support one. If the sources support none, say so explicitly and say why. Any finding that contradicts section A.6 or A.7 is flagged for ESCALATION (Part B's own words: escalated, not silently absorbed) and named in your handoff note so T-375 can disposition it.

SCOPE - RESEARCH ONLY (AB1): no code, no edits under .harness/, no registry writes, no records, no proposal to build the political-economy layer. The Layer-2 research gate stands; a document that recommends building the market layer has exceeded its authorization.

VERIFICATION TIER: DOC TIER per P-024 - the verifier does a BRIEF replay (file exists at the exact path; every substantive claim tagged; Sources section present with the required counts and legitimacy clauses; both mandatory sections present with their exact titles; spot-check that 2 named sources really exist and say which). Deep evaluation happens at T-375, where every contradiction you record gets dispositioned individually.

Hand off with `python3 .harness/bin/blackboard.py handoff --to-role verifier --agent <you>` (never self-mark done). The note must carry: a NUMBERED list of every contradiction and against-the-brief finding, one line each (this list is the input T-375 is charged with dispositioning item by item), plus the 3 findings that most bear on Phase A or Phase B design, each with its tag.

NUMBERED LIST OF EVERY CONTRADICTION / AGAINST-THE-BRIEF FINDING (12 total, for T-375 to disposition item by item):
1. Part B's "resolved by design" claim re: A.3 is unsupported -- AAH2013's Prediction 3 (compositor-verified verbatim) shows fixed entry-cost protocols get MORE damaging as the registry matures, exactly when Phase B activates; the tension is deferred, not resolved.
2. Part B asks Aghion-Howitt 1992 for a healthy/ossifying/chaotic 3-band turnover taxonomy the primary model does not supply (only a signed deviation from a planner benchmark); the closest real taxonomy (Caballero-Hammour) is outside the 2025 laureates' corpus and unverified at full-text level.
3. AB9-OQ1's "priced in Phase B" framing understates a front-loaded risk -- Baslandze (2021) shows standing-defense effort scales with accumulated standing itself, concentrating confirmer-recruitment risk on whichever record/author reaches "consolidada" first. ESCALATION (contradicts A.7).
4. Part C's cell-count/charter-contestability dials have no cap, incubation window, or capability-matching condition, even though the QJE-2005 mechanism validating them is provably non-monotonic and helps only in a neck-and-neck regime.
5. AB9-OQ2 checks only Mokyr; Part B item 2 assigns the SAME open question to Aghion-Howitt's inverted-U too, which AB9 as drafted never checks.
6. PROVISIONAL/unverified: an Etro-style free-entry critique of QJE-2005 may undermine using that model to validate C.4.4's frictionless ius emigrandi -- routed to a future research task, not escalated as settled.
7. AB10's n=1 founding-domain registry is not a neutral baseline under the QJE-2005 model -- it is the model's own zero-competition, low-innovation pole.
8. AB9-OQ1's stated Phase A mitigation (display who confirmed) is directly contradicted by the Newton-Leibniz analog: the confirming committee's roster was fully public and disclosure did not stop the manipulated verdict from standing unchallenged for decades. ESCALATION (contradicts A.6's inflation-control logic).
9. A.8 attributes the Newton-Leibniz dispute's festering to the ABSENCE of an adjudicator; the record shows an adjudicator existed and it festered because that adjudicator was captured -- the opposite half of the story, implying a recusal requirement for the planned appellate verb.
10. A.1's "keystone" framing overstates reputation's real-time stabilizing property -- Newton's gamed reputation was corrected only retrospectively, over 2-3 centuries, by historiography, never by any contemporaneous RoL mechanism.
11. A.1's four founding norms omit two load-bearing historical norms (reciprocity/response-obligation; vouching-based admission control) while A.2 imports only the RoL's exit right -- an asymmetric, romanticized import.
12. TOP 3 FINDINGS MOST BEARING ON PHASE A/B DESIGN, each with tag:
(1) [ESTABLISHED, via Newton-Leibniz/Commercium-Epistolicum primary archival record] AB9-OQ1's Phase-A mitigation (disclosure of who confirmed) is historically falsified as a sufficient control against confirmer-recruitment/citation-cartel gaming; the missing control is confirmer independence/recusal (exclude the author and the author's appointees from the confirming set), needed by PR-015's consolidation mechanism and the future A.8 appellate verb alike -- Contradictions 8+9.
(2) [ESTABLISHED+ANALOGY, via Baslandze 2021 FRB-Atlanta WP + AAH2013] The confirmer-recruitment/standing-defense risk AB9-OQ1 treats as diffuse and "priced in Phase B" is empirically front-loaded, concentrating on whichever record/author first reaches consolidada -- this should gate the A.7 exchange-rate design, not merely be priced into it after the fact -- Contradiction 3.
(3) [ESTABLISHED+ANALOGY, via AAH2013 NBER WP18824 compositor-verified Prediction 3] A.3's overruling-protocol entry cost (the A.3.1 embedding requirement, PRECEDENT.md sec7) is a fixed-shape friction that the growth literature says becomes MORE damaging, not less, as the registry approaches its own maturity/frontier -- exactly when Phase B is designed to activate -- so A.3 defers the turnover-continuity tension rather than resolving it -- Contradiction 1.
